decisions.reason: Changing the editing guide from a Google Doc to a Loom recording does not change the website ownership-transfer destination or artifact.
The guide format decision does not change the selected Basic Webflow hosting plan or its cost-selection rule.
The format of the site-editing instructions does not alter the hero headline or body copy.
The editing-guide recording format does not alter the hero visual, depicted controls, image gallery, or mobile-phone presentation.
The word Loom refers here to the recording format, not to the Loom website used as a visual-style reference.
The editing-guide format does not change the dealer-login button placement or destination URL.
The editing-guide format does not change early-access navigation or its contact-page destination.
The editing-guide format does not change the recipients of contact-form submissions.
The format selected for maintenance instructions does not change the landing page's content composition or screenshot-selection policy.
